title: My Roommate Stole My Lunch Every Day… So I Followed Him
hook: My roommate stole my lunch EVERY day… so I followed him
story: For three weeks, my roommate stole my lunch out of the fridge every single day. I labeled it. I hid it. I even bought a container with a tiny lock, and he just took the whole container. So I set up a camera pointed at the fridge. The next morning, I watched the footage, ready to destroy him. At 6 a.m., he grabs my lunch… and then he grabs his own. He puts both in a bag and walks out. So the next day, I followed him. He walked four blocks to a bus stop, where a little kid with a huge backpack was waiting alone. He handed the kid my lunch, sat with him until the bus came, and walked back home. I found out later the kid's mom works night shifts, and the school had cut his free lunch over a paperwork mistake. My roommate never said a word. He just let me think he was a thief. So the next morning, I didn't confront him. I packed three lunches… and labeled one of them, "For the kid." He hasn't stolen my lunch since. Now he packs mine.
description:
I was ready to fight him. Then I saw where my lunch was going.
